Definition: from G2848 (from the kernel-shape of the insect); crimson-colored:--scarlet (colour, coloured).
KeyPassages: Matthew 27:28; Hebrews 9:19; Revelation 17:3; Revelation 17:4; Revelation 18:12; Revelation 18:16
BiblicalUsage: Kokkinos is scarlet, crimson, the colour of the worm. Matthew 27:28 puts a scarlet robe on Jesus in mockery, Hebrews 9:19 sprinkles the book and the people with scarlet wool, Revelation 17:3 and Revelation 17:4 dress the harlot's beast and the woman in scarlet, and Revelation 18:12 and Revelation 18:16 list scarlet among the merchandise and the clothing of fallen Babylon.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe scarlet is the colour of both the mockery and the atonement: the robe they put on Jesus and the wool that sprinkled the covenant are the same red. I hold that Babylon wears scarlet as a boast, and the Lamb wore it as a robe, and only one of them is clothed in the end.
